idea-plugin.name: Diff Line Stats
idea-plugin.description:
Show per-file added and deleted line counts in the native Git diff tree, including Show Diff with Working Tree. Counts follow the displayed comparison revisions and are calculated in the background.

Early preview tested on IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3. Binary, oversized and unavailable files show a status instead of counts.

在原生 Git 差异文件列表后显示绿色 +新增、红色 −删除行数。 使用列表实际比较的两个版本，后台计算，支持新增、删除、重命名和方向交换。 当前适配 IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2；二进制、超大文件或读取失败会显示明确状态。
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial open-source preview: native diff-tree line counts with background calculation.
